evidence: books/owner-feed.lisp fn-own-feed-parse-response reads only the code; the subject is fn-own-feed-inflight-msgid. RFC 4644 sections 2.4/2.5 require the reply to echo the Message-ID.
fix: For CHECK/TAKETHIS (streaming form) parse the echoed Message-ID and treat a mismatch as a protocol loss (fn-feed-lost: requeue, reconnect re-offers by CHECK); IHAVE replies carry none and keep today's rule.
